messages:
nora: Seeing a sudden uptick in SAST pipeline failures after yesterday's infra RBAC pruning. CI shows `KMS:AccessDenied` on artifact unwraps and a few DAST auth 401s. Blocking a couple of releases.
sec-bot: alert: scan-coordinator failures=48 fail_rate=0.19 delta=+14% recent_error="KMS:AccessDenied" link: https://ci.internal/runs/12011
rahul: That PR switched the scanner SA to assume `sec-scan-role`. The KMS key policy probably still allows the old principal (serviceAccount:scanner@redwood).
isabel: Can someone paste a log snippet? Which key and which principal?
ora: log: ```2024-03-30T21:07:12Z scan ERROR unwrap artifact=gh-9987 error=AccessDeniedException: arn:aws:sts::333333333:assumed-role/sec-scan-role/scanner is not authorized to use key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:333333333:key/aa11-bb22``` We moved from inline SA policy to role-assume to centralize perms.
pat: Quick mitigation: don't disable scans. Open a soft-fail waiver for the scan jobset (infra-oncall can create). In parallel, add the assumed-role ARN to the KMS key policy.
infra-oncall: Waiver created: SOFTFAIL-scan-suite for 60m id=WAIV-20240330-11. Will expire unless extended.
rahul: I'll prepare the key-policy patch. Recommend adding both `arn:aws:iam::333333333:role/sec-scan-role` and `arn:aws:sts::333333333:assumed-role/sec-scan-role/*` so assume variants covered.
isabel: Also noticed a spike in false positives from a recent SAST rule `long-hex-literal` catching generated protobuf artifacts. We should add a repo-level suppression pattern for `gen/*` and lower the severity.
ora: Action items: 1) soft-fail waiver (infra-oncall) 2) patch key policy in staging (rahul) 3) run smoke decrypts (isabel) 4) tune SAST heuristic and add whitelist (pat) 5) add RBAC->KMS checklist to runbook (nora).
sec-bot: created incident: "scan-failure-kms-drift" id=INC-20240330-07 link: https://inc.internal/INC-20240330-07
rahul: Staging key policy patched, smoke decrypt succeeded: `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://c.t --key-id arn:aws:kms:...:key/aa11-bb22 --profile staging-scan` returned plaintext. Preparing prod change after validation.
isabel: Re-ran subset of failing jobs in staging: unwraps ok, SAST flags reduced but still two false positives from proto-gen files. Pat will open small PR to adjust severity and whitelist.
pat: PR opened for config: https://git.internal/sast-config/pull/99 (notes: gen/* whitelist + severity adjust + test).
ora: I'll add a short section in the runbook: "RBAC change -> check KMS key policies that reference old principals -> smoke decrypt -> re-run subset" and add example commands. Also adding a preflight script to infra PR template to scan key policies for removed principals.
infra-oncall: Prod key policy applied, decryption smoke targeted at archived artifacts passed. Waiver will remain until next run completes successfully.
rahul: Long-term: add an automated preflight in infra CI that fails the RBAC change if it removes principals still referenced by KMS key policies.
isabel: Filing a short postmortem and linking the heuristic tuning ticket and infra preflight task. Thanks all for quick turnaround.
